definitions.gloss: replacement item; exchange product; substitute goods
definitions.explanation: An item provided as a replacement for a defective, broken, or unsuitable product. Commonly used in retail, customer service, and warranty contexts.

examples.japanese: {交換品|こうかんひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The replacement item will arrive tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{交換品|こうかんひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: It was defective, so I had them send me a replacement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{交換品|こうかんひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧ほど⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Due to lack of stock, it may take about one week to ship the replacement item.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧ (exchange, replacement) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, goods). This is the standard term used by retailers and manufacturers when providing a substitute product for one that was defective, damaged, or otherwise unsatisfactory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交換品|こうかんひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a replacement item
- {交換品|こうかんひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: for a replacement to arrive
- {交換品|こうかんひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧: arranging a replacement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代替品|だいたいひん}: substitute goods — a broader term for any substitute, not necessarily replacing a defective item
- ⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧: returned goods — the act of returning an item, often the step before receiving a {交換品|こうかんひん}
- {予備品|よびひん}: spare parts — items kept on hand as spares, rather than replacements sent after a problem
